CustomField.description: Client-generated unique key (random session id + Form Template Page Id) so the formTemplate LWC can upsert stages on-demand without requiring a pre-existing record Id. Required for stages-mode preview-window flows where the submission record has no Id until first save.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: System-managed external identifier used by the form runtime to track stage records before they're persisted.
CustomField.label: External Id
